entries.17795620dd2d311e: This is the sole business segment of the SMC Group, which manufactures and sells automatic control equipment, component devices essential to factory automation (FA). Its products consist of pneumatic equipment, including directional control equipment, drive equipment and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, as well as temperature control equipment and sensors, among others. These are component parts built into production and conveying lines of automated factories, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools, industrial robots and other equipment. The company positions itself as a 'general manufacturer of pneumatic equipment' that makes and sells all equipment used on compressed air piping, and cites as its competitive advantage a range of 880,000 items and a short-lead-time, immediate-delivery system backed by ample inventory. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales were ¥842,541 million (up 6.4% year on year), production was ¥843,896 million (up 12.8%), orders received were ¥872,261 million (up 13.2%), order backlog was ¥118,156 million (up 33.6%), and the number of employees was 24,773 (temporary employees of 5,616 are not included).

entries.880d90a369a6197a: It supplies automatic control equipment, consisting of pneumatic equipment such as directional control equipment, actuator equipment, and pneumatic auxiliary equipment, plus temperature control equipment and sensors, with a lineup of 880,000 items. The company describes this as a "one-stop shop" where, if customers order from the group, they can obtain anything in automatic control equipment. Its strength is making products smaller and lighter, and it explains that making pneumatic equipment lighter reduces the weight of equipment and robots, leading to a reduction in energy consumption across the customer's entire factory. About 20% of a factory's power consumption is said to come from the operation of compressors that produce compressed air, and it proposes "4BAR factory," which lowers pneumatic pressure across the entire factory, "AMS (Air Management System)," which constantly monitors air usage and automatically lowers pressure, and "energy-saving booster valves," which boost pressure locally only where needed. Approximately 200 sales staff in more than 50 countries conduct more than 600 "energy-saving diagnostics" per year, and revenue from products defined as "environmentally conscious products" accounts for about 80% of total group revenue. Research and development expenses for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥39,986 million (up 19.9% from the previous fiscal year), and in March 2026 it opened the Japan Technical Center (JTC) in Kashiwa City, Chiba Prefecture as its core research and development base, working with technology centers in the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, and China.
entries.8e4260ee186b4778: Gross profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥381,452 million (up 5.1% from the previous fiscal year), and the gross profit margin fell 0.6 percentage points from the previous fiscal year to 45.3%, mainly due to a rise in the cost ratio and increases in personnel expenses and depreciation. Selling, general and administrative expenses were ¥190,893 million (up 10.5%), operating profit was ¥190,558 million (up 0.2%), and the operating profit margin fell 1.4 percentage points from the previous fiscal year to 22.6%. Because a foreign exchange gain of ¥19,693 million was recorded in non-operating income and expenses (a foreign exchange loss of ¥4,468 million in the previous fiscal year), ordinary profit was ¥235,591 million (up 12.2%), and the ordinary profit margin was 28.0%. Profit before income taxes was ¥236,989 million, and net profit attributable to owners of the parent was ¥167,302 million (up 7.0%). The company explains that steady capital investment worsens profitability in the short term due to the burden of depreciation, but enhances competitiveness over the medium to long term, and expenditures for the acquisition of property, plant and equipment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥152,701 million. The balance of borrowings at the end of the period was ¥5,092 million, and the balance of cash and cash equivalents was ¥573,769 million.

entries.f0022b5cb91b5144: The SMC Group consists of the company and 71 subsidiaries (69 consolidated subsidiaries and 2 non-consolidated subsidiaries), and is a single segment, the automatic control equipment business. The company provides in its management philosophy that its social mission is to “contribute to the automation and labor saving of industry,” and that it will devote itself to its role as a component parts manufacturer and concentrate management resources on its core business, the automatic control equipment business. What it sells is not equipment but component parts incorporated into production and transfer lines in customers' factories, semiconductor manufacturing equipment, machine tools and industrial robots, and the unit price per 1 item is relatively low. However, if a line stops due to a defect or a stock shortage, customers suffer great losses, so immediate delivery with short lead times is extremely important competitively. The company therefore maintains a lineup of 880,000 items and strategically ample inventories, and has a structure to deliver through both direct sales and sales distributors, with a network of more than 500 bases in more than 80 countries and regions around the world and about 7,000 sales staff. Customer accounts number 700,000 companies, and there is no customer accounting for 10% or more of consolidated net sales. The company explains that once a product is adopted, customers tend to continue buying the same product for a long period until they next update the drawings of their lines or equipment.
